cRefPattern.p: Citation by the page and line of the printed edition (CAG page.line, e.g. 105.17): the line with that number after the page break with that page number.

editorialDecl.p: Text transcribed by OCR (Humanitext OCR v2, Gemini models) from the scans named in the source description. Structure (div, quote, head): transferred from a manual division of this work into chapters, sections and lemmata made by Tomomi Nakayama on a TEI file of the work derived from First1KGreek; only the positions of the divisions, the extent of the lemma quotations and the Bekker references were taken over and aligned to the OCR lines by page and opening words, and the result was reviewed in four rounds (2026-08-28 to 2026-09-29). Text: OCR of the page images with line coordinates (gemini-3-flash-preview; gemini-3.7-flash where it failed; damaged pages transcribed again). The review rounds concerned the structure, the line numbers and the placement of the apparatus, not the wording. In October 2026 the text was collated word by word, page by page and in five-line blocks, with the First1KGreek transcription of the same edition (tlg2001.tlg038.1st1K-grc1). Lines on which the two disagreed, lines without a First1KGreek counterpart and lines containing a word form not attested in a Greek form lexicon (about two fifths of the lines) were read again from images of the single lines by gemini-3.8-flash, undecided words line by line by gemini-3.1-pro-preview, and the remaining words were decided on the page image by student assistants or by AI-assisted checking under the editor's supervision. No text was copied from First1KGreek (Open Greek and Latin Project, University of Leipzig; CC BY-SA 4.0): it served only as a collation witness, and every disagreement was decided from the page image of this edition. Spelling follows the printed page. Later checks are listed in the revision description. Headings inside a div (sub-headings, closing formulas, labels of tables) are ab[@type='head']. The words of diagrams and tables are not body text: each diagram or table is given once as figure after the last body line printed before it (labels, trees and tables transcribed; pure geometry described in figDesc); where the edition counts the rows of a diagram or table as lines, those line numbers are not used by any lb. Evident misprints of the printed edition, identified on the page image, are kept and given with the correct form as choice/sic/corr; mere variants of spelling or accentuation are left as printed. Misprinted numbers in milestones (Bekker references, old-edition page, folio, column and line numbers), which cannot carry choice/sic/corr, are given with the corrected value where the sequence of the numbers determines it. Line breaks: one lb per printed line; @n is the line count of the CAG page (headings included), resynchronised on the printed marginal numbers of the left margin; lines the edition does not count carry lb without @n. Words hyphenated across lines are joined and the lb is placed at the following word boundary. pb/@facs points to the image of the page in the Internet Archive item named in the source description (BookReader page image; for pages supplied from another copy, that copy). Critical-apparatus entries are attached to the line(s) they cite as note[@type='apparatus'] with @target on the lb (line level; the lemma words of an entry are not linked); entries that cannot be resolved remain as note[@type='footnote'] at the page end. References in the margins to older editions or manuscripts are milestone[@type='alt-edition'] with @unit and @ed (the edition identified from the preface of the volume); CAG's repetition of the current old-edition page or folio beside the first line of each page is not encoded. Bekker references printed before lemmata are milestone[@unit='bekker']. Marginal digits fused into the text by OCR have been removed.

revisionDesc.change: OCR of the page images with line coordinates (gemini-3-flash-preview; gemini-3.7-flash where it failed); division of the text transferred onto the OCR lines.
Four review rounds of the structure, line numbers and apparatus placement; damaged pages transcribed again; lines dropped by the OCR inserted.
Line numbers recounted from the printed marginal numerals in OCR reading order.

Text re-read like the other CAG works, collated with First1KGreek where a First1KGreek file could be aligned (32,001 lines of the Greek pilot works by gemini-3.8-flash, 4,222 by gemini-3.1-pro-preview); remaining words decided on the page images.
Margin references to older editions encoded as milestone[@type='alt-edition'][@ed] and checked on the images.
Words hyphenated across lines joined; punctuation normalised; review closed.

Header revised (title, source description, editorial declaration, revision description); supplement brackets normalised to 〈 〉; breathings and accents written as separate signs before capitals composed with the letter; missing elision marks after ἀλλ, κατ, καθ, ἐπ, δι etc. supplied in the text; numbers left at line starts removed or encoded as old-edition milestones (image checked); words divided at a line end that had been joined to a word two lines down corrected; every body line without a line number checked on the page images (margin labels and folio marks read as lines dropped, duplicated rows removed, a missing line restored, numbers given to lines the edition counts); numeral signs unified as ʹ (U+0374, stored in its NFC form U+02B9); line-number jumps, old-edition milestones without an edition name and notes suspected to hold body text checked on the page images; citation by printed page and line declared (refsDecl); raised dots read as apostrophes corrected (checked on the page images); line coordinates of the working files realigned on the marginal numerals; printers' signatures at the foot of the page removed from the apparatus; apparatus entries for two lines joined by et kept as one note pointing at both lines; text of diagrams and tables encoded as figure (18 pages checked on the images); page images linked from pb/@facs.

Old-edition line numbers checked on the page images where the sequence skipped a number (2,100 places in the corpus) and, page by page, where it was irregular (542 pages): numbers missed by the OCR added (549), milestones not printed on the page dropped (190; mostly the CAG's own left-margin numbers or line references of the apparatus taken for old-edition numbers), misplaced ones moved (69), misread values corrected (31), page numbers taken for line numbers made page milestones (8); the edition's own skips and out-of-order numbers left as printed, the line count printed beside the repeated page or folio at the head of a page not encoded (like the repetition).
p. 29: l. 15, divided by the OCR at the page bar of Spengel's edition, joined again, and l. 21, missed by the OCR, read from the page image.

Quotation marks made uniform: opening single and double quotation marks, printed in the edition in the reversed (high-reversed-9) form, are encoded as ‘ and “, closing ones as ’ and ”, single and double kept as printed; opening marks read by the OCR as straight quotes, low quotes or spacing breathings, and spacing breathings or quotation marks doubled before a capital that already bears its breathing, corrected.
Spengel p. 69 placed at the bar printed inside ἑκά|στῳ (p. 43, l. 14), found in the adjudication of the accuracy evaluation.

Apparatus entries printed out of numerical order (e.g. 33 … 32) separated from the preceding entry; words hyphenated across lines joined in Latin text as in Greek; words mixing Greek and Latin letters (OCR errors, about 130, including manuscript sigla) corrected on the page images; marginal folio marks left in the text removed; validated against TEI P5 version 4.12.0 (recorded in TEI/@version).
